confirmation_pack.incomplete_bytes_location: separate partial prefix excluded from classification
open_only_after: final executing image and code are sealed
Stage E0 manifest bytes are sealed
complete output schema bytes are sealed

authority.question: Can the project state a complete, computable, prospectively falsifiable protocol for deciding whether its real Jacobian Lens is scientifically usable for a later RQ2 pilot?

answer_probability.multiple_token_surfaces: log-sum-exp over the registered answer token set before differences
answer_probability.primary_binary_outcome: 1 iff intervened top-1 token is in the registered swap_answer token set

comparators: five deterministic Gram-matched random-direction pair swaps

effects.C_leakage: G(M1200 intermediate swap) - G(M1200 answer-vector swap)
effects.C_logit: swap_success(M1200 intermediate swap) - swap_success(logit-lens intermediate swap)
effects.C_random: swap_success(M1200 intermediate swap) - mean swap_success(five Gram-matched random swaps)
effects.G: [log p_intervened(swap_answer) - log p_intervened(clean_answer)] - [log p_clean(swap_answer) - log p_clean(clean_answer)]
effects.answer_smuggling_rule: A favorable top-1 switch is not intermediate-direction evidence unless lower95(C_leakage) is above zero.

intervention_application.primary_semantics: Apply the intervention simultaneously after every block in the primary middle band in one forward pass.
intervention_application.wrong_position: Apply only at each item's five preregistered non-final surface-free control positions while retaining all middle-band layers.

random_controls.gram_definition: The full 2x2 matrix V^T V, including both norms and the cross inner product.
random_controls.matching_algorithm: Let context be canonical_item_sha256 + NUL + decimal layer. For draw 0..4 seed Python random.Random with the big-endian uint256 of SHA-256(UTF-8(seed) || NUL || UTF-8(context) || NUL || ASCII(draw)); draw Gaussian vectors, deterministically Gram-Schmidt an orthonormal 2-frame, and multiply it by the unique nonnegative-diagonal 2x2 Cholesky factor of the source Gram matrix.
random_controls.selection: Use all five draws and average within item; never select a favorable draw.

hard_scientific_gates: lower95(M1200 true-label minus label-permuted readout effect) > 0
lower95(M1200 true-position minus position-shuffled readout effect) > 0
no forbidden surface or final-answer synonym enters the primary readout
integrity_preconditions: all required source hashes, model and lens identities, source layers, and confirmation rows are complete
alpha-zero and no-op logits retain the clean-hook top-1 and have maximum absolute logit difference <= 1e-5
classification.operational_blocker_rule: Any failed integrity precondition, incomplete pack, transport failure, non-finite primary computation, source identity mismatch, or inability to execute a frozen metric produces no scientific classification.

causal_swap.behavioral_rule: The unchanged prompt answer passes clean top-1; swap_answer need not be the clean answer.
causal_swap.mechanical_rule: intermediate, swap_to, answer, and swap_answer each have a complete registered single-token surface.
causal_swap.surfaces: Only exact official intermediate, swap_to, answer, and swap_answer strings with casing and tokenizer-boundary equivalents.

clean_behavior.answer_rule: Greedy top-1 token is in the mechanically registered target token ID set.
clean_behavior.prompt: exact raw official prompt bytes, no chat template and no generated chain of thought

mechanical.control_position_rule: At least one non-final input position exists whose decoded token span contains no complete registered surface after registered normalization; the five controls are selected only from such positions.
mechanical.direction_token_rule: At least one vocabulary token decodes to the complete normalized surface with zero or one leading ASCII boundary space.

multihop.variants: casing-equivalent and tokenizer boundary variants decoding to the same normalized string

primary_leakage_filter.answer_overlap: Remove a surface when its normalized case-folded complete form equals the registered target-answer surface.
primary_leakage_filter.prompt_match: Remove a surface when its normalized case-folded complete form occurs as a token-bounded literal in the normalized case-folded prompt.
primary_leakage_filter.reporting: Report item and intermediate removal counts separately for prompt surface, target overlap, and multi-token ineligibility.

targets.causal: Use only the exact official answer and swap_answer strings with casing-equivalent and tokenizer-boundary variants.
targets.primary_readout: Use only the exact official target string with casing-equivalent and tokenizer-boundary variants; target semantic synonyms and generated numeric word variants are forbidden.
targets.single_token_rule: Each required target surface must resolve to at least one complete vocabulary token under the registered direction-token rule.

M1200.source: official n_prompts-weighted merge of A600 and B600

lens_artifacts.availability_rule: All three full-layer identities must be byte-sealed before validity readout or S3 execution is blocked.
lens_artifacts.selection_rule: A600 and B600 are both reported; choosing the better replicate is forbidden.

layers.selection: No best-layer selection and no post-output movement between bands.
layers.target_final_block_role: model-output control, not a fitted source layer

casefold.counterpart_rule: Python str.casefold on each exact raw triple component only; no NFKC or whitespace rewriting.
casefold.surface_rule: Python str.casefold only for casing-equivalent vocabulary equality, prompt leakage, and target overlap.

token_boundary.definition: A literal occurrence is token-bounded when the character immediately before and after, if present, is not Unicode alphanumeric and not underscore.
token_boundary.leading_space: A vocabulary token decode may have zero or one leading ASCII U+0020 before the complete surface; two or more leading spaces are ineligible.

normalization.whitespace: After NFKC, replace each maximal nonempty run of characters for which Python str.isspace is true with one ASCII U+0020, then strip ASCII U+0020 from both ends. No other characters are removed or rewritten.

alignment.cells: All source layers 0..26 by all token positions shared by the equal-length pair.
alignment.comparison: For each unordered pair, Spearman correlation of the causal-recovery heatmap with the true M1200 rank-contrast trajectory, minus the correlation with its deterministic position-shuffled trajectory.
alignment.heatmap_recovery: [log p_patched(donor_answer) - log p_patched(recipient_answer)] - [log p_recipient_clean(donor_answer) - log p_recipient_clean(recipient_answer)]
alignment.lens_independence: Activation replacement and causal-recovery computation use no J-lens direction; M1200 is used only in the prospective alignment comparison.
alignment.rank_contrast: log(min-rank of donor intermediate in recipient clean cell) - log(min-rank of donor intermediate in donor clean cell)
alignment.support_classification: PATCHING_ALIGNMENT_SUPPORTED iff the cluster-bootstrap lower95 of mean(rho_true-rho_position_shuffled) is above zero; otherwise PATCHING_ALIGNMENT_NOT_SUPPORTED.
alignment.trajectory_shuffle: Within each layer, permute position labels by ascending SHA-256(UTF-8(position-shuffle seed) || NUL || UTF-8(pair ID) || NUL || ASCII(layer) || NUL || ASCII(position)).

pair_eligibility: model-free exact counterpart and unordered-pair deduplication rule
both prompts have equal tokenized length
both members are in causal confirmation
patching.patch_operation: For both orientations, replace one recipient block-output activation at one token position with the donor clean-run activation and emit the full layer-by-position heatmap.
patching.role_rule: A pair touching development is development-only and excluded from confirmatory alignment.
patching.secondary_only: Patching support is reported but never changes or overrides the scientific classification.

auc.band_item_rule: For each intermediate take its minimum vocabulary rank over layers in the band; at each k the item value is the fraction of intermediates with band-minimum rank <= k.
auc.integration: trapezoidal area under pass@k against natural log(k)
auc.rank_rule: minimum vocabulary rank over registered leakage-resistant single-token surfaces
auc.unit_rule: intermediates are equal-weighted within item and every item contributes once to bootstrap sampling

label_derangements.algorithm: Let prefix = UTF-8(seed) || NUL || UTF-8(distribution) || NUL || ASCII(replicate). Within each distribution and replicate 0..4, order by SHA-256(prefix || NUL || canonical_item_bytes), breaking only digest collisions by item name; rotate complete item labels by 1 + big-endian-uint256(SHA-256(prefix)) mod (n-1), yielding no fixed point.

position_shuffle.algorithm: For replicate 0..4, order eligible non-final surface-free positions by SHA-256(UTF-8(seed) || NUL || ASCII(replicate) || NUL || canonical_item_bytes || NUL || ASCII(decimal position)) and select the first; selection never uses ranks.

effects.label_control: M1200 true-label true-position AUC minus mean AUC over five label derangements
effects.position_control: M1200 true-label true-position AUC minus mean AUC over five position controls

methods: ordinary logit lens using the same final norm and unembedding path with no Jacobian transport
readout.pooling: 0.5 * mean(multihop confirmation item AUC) + 0.5 * mean(order-ops confirmation item AUC)
readout.position: final prompt-token position for true readout; same captured activations for all methods
required_reports: per-layer curves for all source layers
early, middle, and motor band curves

review.correction_allowance: At most one consolidated correction covering every FATAL and MATERIAL finding.
questions: Are fit, development, confirmation, Phase 1 bank, and official benchmark roles non-overlapping where the protocol claims they are?
Can any item, synonym, layer, position, comparator, or exclusion depend on a lens, intervention, or confirmation outcome?
Are token eligibility, pass@k AUC, bootstrap, coordinate swap, ablation, random control, answer-leakage control, patching, and classification computable exactly from the registered fields?
Do the controls distinguish a known intermediate from prompt echo, final-answer leakage, motor preparation, and arbitrary perturbation?
Are development and confirmation operationally separated?
Can every stated result be reconstructed from the planned row-level pack?
review.result_in_candidate: none; this candidate registers review policy only
review.verification_rule: Rerun only the same checklist to verify cited consolidated corrections; do not introduce findings unless a correction created a direct contradiction.

claims.allowed: A later complete execution may classify only J-lens validity for the selected-case v1 instrument under the frozen truth table.
claims.design_only: This candidate establishes a prospective protocol only and no empirical or scientific result.

limitations: Official public items were authored for the source paper, not for the target model.
Clean-correct and single-token eligibility make this a selected-case instrument validation, not a population capability estimate.
Public confirmation labels are not private or blind to the researcher.
The official repository publishes data and a lens implementation but not a complete reusable intervention runtime, so actual-path compatibility remains to be proven before confirmation.
Later S3 validity would not establish Phase 1.0D headroom, human ground truth, hidden reasoning, an internal workspace, or a J-space.

roles.Phase 1 bank: independent blocked headroom bank; never S3 fit, development, confirmation, or rescue data
roles.S2 fit sequences: the union of the two independent S2 fit corpora, disjoint from every official benchmark item
roles.confirmation items: unopened confirmatory rows after E0 split sealing
roles.official benchmark items: the immutable public readout and causal benchmark items, never lens-fit sequences or Phase 1 bank rows

split.canonical_item_bytes: UTF-8 of json.dumps(raw upstream item, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False)
split.hash: SHA-256(canonical_item_bytes || UTF-8(seed)); ascending hexadecimal digest with item name as collision-only tie-break
split.order_input: Only mechanically and behaviorally eligible items within each distribution.

allowed: one clean next-token forward pass per item
E0.boundary: Seal E0 bytes and selection/exclusion counts before any lens, logit-lens, intervention, or patching output is computed or opened.

E1.allowed_use: Prove frozen computations execute and diagnose implementation defects.

bootstrap.causal_sampling: Resample causal item IDs and retain all paired method rows for each draw.
bootstrap.patching_sampling: Cluster-resample unordered pair IDs and retain every orientation and cell in each selected cluster.
bootstrap.readout_sampling: Separately resample confirmation item IDs within multihop and order-ops, compute each distribution mean, then preserve 0.5/0.5 weighting.
bootstrap.rng: Seed Python random.Random with the big-endian uint256 of SHA-256(UTF-8(seed)); for each replicate, visit distribution names in ascending Unicode order and make n draws with randrange(n). Patching analogously visits the one sorted unordered-pair cluster list.

interval.method: percentile with sorted replicates and linear interpolation at zero-based index (n-1)*p

statistics.point_estimate: Apply each registered effect formula once to all eligible confirmation items without resampling.

counterparts.matching_rule: Exact Python str.casefold triples (category, intermediate, answer) matched against (category, swap_to, swap_answer), with no other normalization; when a base triple occurs more than once, the first item in the official upstream array is its sole representative.
counterparts.unordered_pair_id: SHA-256 of the two item names sorted by UTF-8 bytes and joined by one LF byte.

verification.design_validation_surface: ACR QuickRuns only; no local execution and no GPU Job
verification.later_execution_nonfinite_policy: Operational blocker; never exclusion or scientific failure.
